title: Musk celebrates Tesla’s top market spot in Korea
caption:
Tesla has secured the top spot for imported cars in Korea for nine months straight. The brand saw a 110 percent jump in registrations last month.

Source: Koreaherald - Musk celebrates Tesla’s top market spot in Korea
